rationale: The agent verified identity using full name plus zip, matched to a single user via tools, and operated only on that user’s account. They inspected recent orders with read-only calls, correctly identified that only the delivered order (#W1679211) was return-eligible, and enumerated the exact items to be returned (E-Reader, Jigsaw Puzzle, T-Shirt) while keeping the tablet. The agent requested and received explicit confirmation (twice) and selected the specified refund method (the user’s PayPal), then executed the return with the correct item IDs. Finally, they provided a clear refund amount breakdown that aligns with the item prices observed for at least the E-Reader and plausibly for the others; no evidence contradicts these amounts. No writes were made without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported fabrications are evident. Minor uncertainties (some tool outputs truncated) do not indicate policy violations.
